fix(zoom): apply every zoom change when they happen back-to-back

Calling `zoomIn()`, `zoomOut()` or `changeZoom()` more than once before the lightbox re-rendered
(e.g., twice in the same event handler) started each call after the first from the stale zoom
level and offsets, so `zoomIn(); zoomIn()` zoomed in only once and `zoomIn(); zoomOut()` zoomed out
from the original level. The same happened to wheel and pinch gestures and drag panning on React
18+, where consecutive wheel or pointer move events can arrive before React re-renders (e.g., on a
slow device), dropping part of the zoom or pan. Each change now builds on the zoom level and
offsets set by the previous one.
